description: This file implements a test stub for the Rialto session server, including a mock service class, socket communication setup, and methods to simulate client interactions such as sending events and disconnecting.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: A mock implementation of the rialto::ServerManagerModule used for testing, which responds to RPC calls with programmed responses.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket pairs and server factory.

methods.name: ~RialtoSessionServerStub
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up client connections and thread.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server stub with a specified response behavior.

methods.name: getClientSocket
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor for client communication.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to the client.

methods.name: sendAckEvent
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment event with a ping ID and success status.
